title: How Wasmer used Codex to build a Node.js runtime for the edge
summary: See how Wasmer used Codex with GPT-5.5 to build a Node.js runtime for the edge, accelerating development 10x to 20x and shipping in weeks instead of months.
body: See how Wasmer used Codex with GPT-5.5 to build a Node.js runtime for the edge, accelerating development 10x to 20x and shipping in weeks instead of months.
summaryZh: 本文详细介绍了Wasmer公司如何借助OpenAI的Codex与GPT-5.5模型，构建用于边缘计算的Node.js运行时。该开发过程展示了AI编程助手在复杂系统开发中的强大效能，使开发速度提升了10到20倍，将原本需要数月的工作缩短至数周内完成，为边缘端基础设施建设提供了成功的行业落地案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了企业如何利用先进大模型和代码辅助工具大幅加速软件开发和边缘计算架构的构建。
